result.title: Boundary Mass in Feature Space as a Label-Budget Diagnostic for Representations
result.summary: Low-label transfer is often decided by a practical question: after a representation looks useful, how many labels are still needed to learn the downstream boundary? Transferability and probe-quality scores characterize global alignment, likelihood, margins, and calibration. Boundary-near target mass complements these diagnostics by measuring the ambiguous regions where scarce labels are most costly. We propose effective boundary complexity, a label-budget diagnostic for frozen representations and linear probes. It measures mass in a thin strip around the learned boundary and normalizes it by class balance, so dense ambiguous regions and predicted-class imbalance are both counted. We prove that, under a smooth representation map, density change and tangential surface change cancel at first order, leaving boundary-normal stretch or compression as the governing factor. This yields a cached-feature estimator that fits a probe on one split and counts independent held-out features near its boundary. Experiments support the diagnostic at three levels. Controlled transformations match the predicted law across 74 maps with 0.38% median relative error. On real frozen features, normal-direction changes move both measured boundary mass and label demand, while tangent controls preserve the first-order coefficient. A differentiable surrogate reduces measured complexity by 16-36% at matched top-1 utility. Finally, CIFAR-100 and Tiny-ImageNet experiments support boundary mass as a second-stage diagnostic for near-tied representations. Five-way experiments show strong OvR-interface backbone-ranking agreement (Spearman 0.872), while acquisition experiments show high correlations between initial boundary mass and realized label budgets across three sampling policies (0.779-0.830). Code is available at https://github.com/qqaqq-code/boundary_mass.

AI.brief_summary: 提出「effective boundary complexity」，以冻结特征上线性探针决策边界附近的样本质量（按类别平衡归一）作为标签预算诊断指标，理论上说明平滑表示下法向拉伸是主导因素，并给出基于缓存特征的估计器，在受控变换与 CIFAR-100、Tiny-ImageNet 上验证其与标签需求的相关性。
AI.relevance_reason: 与视觉推理主线无直接关系，但其在缓存特征上度量判别边界模糊质量与标签需求的方法线索，可能可供核查 LVR 内部隐状态表示的判别边界、模糊区域及所需监督量，属表示几何类诊断的可借鉴工具。
